description: This file defines the main page component for a React-based notes application frontend. It manages user authentication state, renders authentication modal if unauthenticated, and displays main UI components such as Header, Sidebar, and NotesMain upon successful login.

methods.name: Home
methods.description: Main React component managing authentication state and rendering main UI components for the notes application.

methods.name: handleLogin
methods.description: Handles login success by setting the token and updating UI state.

methods.name: handleLogout
methods.description: Handles user logout by removing the token and prompting for authentication.
